comment_regular: GetCurrentTime_Eval reads TimeGlobals::GameHour and returns the numeric hour for the enclosing CTDA comparison; it has no parameters or subject requirement. Vanilla core dialogue uses it 23 times. Fallout's later counterpart x4y6:0x823B4BC8 reads Calendar::GetHour, so the owning time subsystem differs.
